def render_g_custo_por_transportadora(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Input validation
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None:
        # Fallback to first dataframe if explicit name not found
        if dataframes:
            df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
        else:
            return  # No data available

    if df.empty or 'carrier' not in df.columns or 'cost' not in df.columns:
        # Cannot render, just draw empty placeholder
        return

    # Aggregate total cost per carrier
    cost_per_carrier = df.groupby('carrier', observed=True)['cost'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

    # Colors for clarity
    bar_colors = ['#4C72B0', '#55A868', '#C44E52']  # blue, green, red

    # Create matplotlib figure
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4))

    # Bar positions
    categories = cost_per_carrier.index.tolist()
    values = cost_per_carrier.values.tolist()

    bars = ax.bar(categories, values, color=bar_colors[:len(categories)], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

    # Add data labels with percent headroom
    max_val = max(values)
    ax.set_ylim(0, max_val * 1.20)  # 20% room for labels

    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() + max_val * 0.02,
                f'R$ {val:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')

    # Titles and labels
    ax.set_title('Custo Total por Transportadora', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold', pad=8)
    ax.set_ylabel('Custo Total (R$)', fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel('')  # Omit x-axis label, carrier names are enough

    # Finish axis styling
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=8)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelsize=7)

    # Adjust layout to fit title and labels inside the box
    fig.subplots_adjust(top=0.88, bottom=0.12, left=0.15, right=0.95)

    # Save to temporary file
    import tempfile
    import os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.png', delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close(fig)
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_atraso_por_armazem(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Retrieve the shipment quality dataframe
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # Check required columns
    if 'warehouse' not in df.columns or 'late_pct' not in df.columns:
        return

    # Compute mean late_pct per warehouse, sort descending (worst first)
    avg_late = df.groupby('warehouse', sort=False)['late_pct'].mean().reset_index()
    avg_late = avg_late.sort_values('late_pct', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Prepare data for plotting
    warehouses = avg_late['warehouse'].tolist()
    values = avg_late['late_pct'].tolist()

    # Create figure sized according to component dimensions (mm -> inches)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4), constrained_layout=True)

    # Bar chart
    colors = ['#e74c3c', '#f39c12', '#27ae60']  # red, orange, green for ranking
    bars = ax.bar(warehouses, values, color=colors[:len(warehouses)], edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)

    # Add value labels above bars
    for bar, val in zip(bars, values):
        ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height() + 0.1,
                f'{val:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

    # Overall average line (from calculated metric m_avg_atraso)
    overall_avg = 4.8  # from metrics
    ax.axhline(y=overall_avg, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.6)
    ax.text(len(warehouses) - 0.3, overall_avg + 0.2, f'Média geral: {overall_avg:.1f}%',
            fontsize=7, color='gray', ha='right', va='bottom', style='italic')

    # Labels and title
    ax.set_xlabel('')
    ax.set_ylabel('Percentual médio de atraso (%)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Percentual médio de atraso por armazém', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=8)

    # Formatting
    ax.set_ylim(0, max(values) * 1.25)  # headroom for labels
    ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)
    ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.3)

    # Remove top/right spines
    for spine in ['top', 'right']:
        ax.spines[spine].set_visible(False)

    # Save to temporary file and insert into PDF
    import tempfile
    import os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close(fig)
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR', '/tmp/matplotlib')
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from fpdf import FPDF, XPos, YPos
import tempfile
import textwrap

sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid')

def _safe_pdf_text(value):
    replacements = {
        '\u2013': '-', '\u2014': '-', '\u2015': '-',
        '\u2018': "'", '\u2019': "'", '\u201c': '"', '\u201d': '"',
        '\u2022': '-', '\u00a0': ' ', '\u2026': '...'
    }
    text = str(value or '')
    for source, target in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(source, target)
    return text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')

def _wrap_lines(text, max_chars):
    lines = []
    for paragraph in str(text).splitlines() or ['']:
        wrapped = textwrap.wrap(paragraph.strip(), width=max_chars) or ['']
        lines.extend(wrapped)
    return lines

def _sentence_chunks(text):
    normalized = ' '.join(str(text).split())
    chunks, current = [], []
    for token in normalized.split(' '):
        current.append(token)
        if token.rstrip().endswith(('.', '!', '?', ';')):
            chunks.append(' '.join(current))
            current = []
    if current:
        chunks.append(' '.join(current))
    return chunks or [normalized]

def _fit_text_to_box(text, w, h, font_size, line_height):
    max_chars = max(14, int(w * 0.55 * (10 / max(font_size, 1))))
    max_lines = max(1, int(h / max(line_height, 1)))
    if len(_wrap_lines(text, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
        return text
    selected = []
    for sentence in _sentence_chunks(text):
        candidate = ' '.join(selected + [sentence]).strip()
        if not candidate:
            continue
        if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
            selected.append(sentence)
        elif selected:
            break
        else:
            words = sentence.split()
            compact = []
            for word in words:
                candidate = ' '.join(compact + [word])
                if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) > max_lines:
                    break
                compact.append(word)
            selected.append(' '.join(compact))
            break
    fitted = ' '.join(selected).strip()
    return fitted

def _write_report_title(pdf, title, font_family):
    clean_title = ' '.join(_safe_pdf_text(title or 'Relatório Analítico').split())
    for size in range(16, 10, -1):
        max_chars = max(28, int(58 * (16 / size)))
        lines = textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=max_chars) or [clean_title]
        if len(lines) <= 2:
            pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', size)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, '\n'.join(lines), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')
            return
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 11)
    pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=84)), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')

def render_text_block(pdf, text, x, y, w, h, title=None):
    font_size = 10
    line_height = 5
    text = _safe_pdf_text(text)
    title = _safe_pdf_text(title) if title else None
    body_height = h
    pdf.set_xy(x, y)
    if title:
        pdf.set_font('helvetica', 'B', font_size)
        pdf.cell(w, 7, title, new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT)
        body_height = max(1, h - 8)
        pdf.set_xy(x, pdf.get_y())
    
    fitted_text = _fit_text_to_box(text, w, body_height, font_size, line_height)
    pdf.set_font('helvetica', '', font_size)
    pdf.multi_cell(w, line_height, fitted_text, align='J')
